accepted.shopify_niche: Shopify agency - store design and development (partner prospect)
accepted.product_category: Shopify store design, development, setup to launch
accepted.buying_intent: Medium - Shopify build agency whose clients need ongoing listing and content work after launch; partnership/resell angle
accepted.personalization_detail: Byron Bay based agency that builds Shopify stores from setup to launch, backed by 25+ years in digital advertising
accepted.personalization_reason: Clients who have just launched a Shopify store often still face the ongoing work of writing listings, tags and promo content, which an AI assistant add-on could cover as a post-launch service
accepted.personalized_opening: Your team takes Byron Bay businesses from Shopify setup all the way to launch, and I'm writing because the work that usually lands on clients after launch is exactly where I spend my time.
accepted.subject_line: Post-launch add-on for your Shopify clients
accepted.email_body:
Hi Team,

Your team takes businesses from Shopify setup all the way to launch, and I'm writing because the work that usually lands on clients after launch is exactly where I spend my time.

I build AI "Jarvis" assistants for Shopify stores using n8n with OpenAI or Gemini. They draft product titles, descriptions and SEO text, apply tags and collections, prepare promo and social content, and send simple store reports. For an agency, that could sit alongside your builds as a white-label or referral add-on, so clients keep getting value once the store is live and you don't need to build the automation side in-house.

Would you be open to a short call to see whether a partnership like that would suit a few of your clients?

Best regards,
Cynthia Nana

accepted.subject_line: Listing help for WashiGang's sticker sheets
accepted.email_body:
Hi Team,

With so many individual washi designs and sticker sheets on WashiGang, every new batch must mean a long run of titles, descriptions and tags to write.

That caught my attention because it's the work I help Shopify stores with. I build AI "Jarvis" assistants using n8n and OpenAI or Gemini that draft product titles and descriptions in your own voice, suggest SEO text and tags, sort items into collections, and prepare social posts for new drops. You stay in control and approve everything before it goes live.

Would it be useful if I showed you how this could work on one of your recent sticker or washi releases?

Best regards,
Cynthia Nana
